name: Yunding Temple
_about: YUNDING TEMPLE (an original design): a Chan Buddhist mountain monastery climbing a cove in four terraces along one axis -- the pailou and the 108 steps, the Hall of Heavenly Kings between the bell and drum towers, the great court in its cloisters with the side halls, the double-eaved Mahavira Hall (the Three Buddhas, the arhats, Guanyin), the seven-storey octagonal pagoda with its balconies and stairs to the lookout, the sutra library and the cloud-viewing pavilion; the Garden of Released Life with its pond and zig-zag bridge beside the approach. Generated by tools/archgen/yunding.py (its docstring is the design). South is +z, the foot of the climb.
